generate-e2e.description: Compose an AI prompt for a Playwright e2e test from a plain-english user story. Optionally verify a generated spec file.

verify-e2e.description: Run static verification (ESLint + tsc + structural checks) on a Playwright spec file.

oneshot-e2e.description: One-shot demo: compose the prompt, invoke Claude headlessly to write the spec, then run static verification.
